To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the cancer network activity is a global measure of the cancer cell activity that can be exploited for the prediction of therapeutic responses, and that it is based on the analysis of omic and network data.
cancer therapeutic response can be predicted on basis of a systems level analysis of molecular interactions, and that the major cancer drivers mediate the response.
the cancer cell line-specific expression levels of protein interactions are associated with the therapeutic response and synergistic combinations for cancer therapy can be predicted on this basis.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a comprehensive mechanistic approach to cancer therapy.
the identification of cancer network activity, which can be used to predict cancer therapeutic response and synergistic combinations of drugs.
the integration of omic data and the application of network theory to the study of cancer cell behavior and drug response.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
CNA is a measure of the activity of the cancer cell, and that this measure is useful to predict therapeutic response.
the CNA measure is a promising tool for the rational design of personalized cancer therapy.
the cancer network activity is an important and generalizable feature of the cancer cells and their therapeutic responses.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the CNA is a global measure of the activity of the cancer cells that can be used to predict the response to a given therapy.
cancer network activity is an integrative and predictive feature of cancer biology and therapy.
the CNA measure can be used to predict the efficacy of drugs and drug combinations, as well as to predict the synergies between drugs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
cancer network activity is an important measure of the molecular state of a cancer cell that can be exploited to identify therapeutic strategies.
the CNA measure can be used to identify novel therapeutic combinations that can be tested in clinical trials.
the network analysis of gene expression data can be used to predict the efficacy of a given therapy in cancer cells and to suggest synergistic combinations of drugs.
